headline: Open-weight GLM-5.3 nearly matches Claude at building exploits
body: Cyber capability dominated. Anthropic's red team said Zhipu's open-weight GLM-5.3 built end-to-end exploits in 50 of 410 attempts, close to Claude Mythos Preview's 56, and its refusals were easily bypassed. Powerful hacking ability that anyone can download raises Catastrophic Risk, the main driver of Self-Destruction. Google released Gemini 4 Argon first to vetted cyber defenders, saying it can autonomously find, validate and fix critical vulnerabilities; that adds capability and autonomy, lifting Conquerors, Descendants and Zookeeper. OpenAI also accused Moonshot-linked users of a coordinated distillation campaign, a small strain on Global Coordination. Horizon Balance fell to -12.81.
movers_note: Self-Destruction +1.2 (GLM-5.3 +1.09, distillation campaign +0.10), Conquerors +0.7 (Gemini 4 Argon +0.38, GLM-5.3 +0.30) and Libertarian Utopia -0.5 (GLM-5.3 -0.50).
